entries.0597bfa8b4ba319d: Online site for used car transactions
entries.12f0095d8bcc08c2: It is a business that conducts pre-shipment inspections of used automobiles for export, and vehicle inspections and roadworthiness certification (shaken) for imported vehicles in New Zealand. JEVIC Co., Ltd. is accredited by the authorities of New Zealand and Australia to conduct road safety inspections and quarantine inspections to check vehicle bodies for soil and animal or plant matter. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,323 million.
entries.4c6a0a364266a207: Land Transport, Storage and Servicing of New Cars
entries.75d22bf865763bed: It is the largest business in the group, engaged in the retail and wholesale of new and used automobiles, mainly in Australia. Its core company, Autopact Holdings Pty Ltd, operates 142 dealerships across three eastern states and sells new cars of about 40 brands, including those from Japan, the United States, Europe and China. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥220,185 million.
entries.874bcb23208c3074: It purchases used automobiles in Japan and sells them for export to local dealers overseas. Its core company, Nichibo Co., Ltd., mainly purchases used automobiles from auto auction operators and sells them mainly in New Zealand. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, Nichibo's vehicle sales volume was 49,611 units, and its revenue from external customers was ¥53,859 million.
entries.973c9c4d16fddeff: Used car dealers in New Zealand
entries.9b6b3440e514e964: Inspection of Imported Vehicles and Roadworthiness Certification
entries.ab92119d5ef682f8: It is a business responsible for sea transport of used automobiles exported from Japan and land transport of new cars in Australia. Dolphin Shipping New Zealand Limited conducts non-vessel-operating shipping business without owning vessels, and Autocare Services Pty Ltd handles transport, storage and pre-delivery servicing of imported new cars in Australia. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥32,921 million.
entries.cea03fa0a1f55813: This is not a reportable segment. It consists of the company, a pure holding company, and an intermediate holding company that oversees regional headquarters functions for Australia and New Zealand. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥354 million.
entries.dddf28310be29471: A holding company of automotive-related services that, centered on Australia and New Zealand, handles the import and export of used cars, inspection and logistics, and local sales of new and used cars.
entries.efb83643e4b7f9c7: It is a service business for used car dealers and general consumers in New Zealand. Auto Finance Direct Limited provides automobile loans to general consumers, and Auto Trader Media Group Limited operates an online site for used car transactions. In Australia, the company also sells automobile-related data. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,863 million.
